name: Privacy-Preserved Document Image Classification Benchmark
description: A comprehensive benchmark evaluating document image classification methods under privacy-preservation constraints.
reputation: A recent, specialised dataset introduced in 2024 targeting privacy-preserving document classification; it is gaining attention in document analysis and privacy research but not yet widely adopted.
notes: Designed for privacy-preserving settings; potential caveats include domain shift across document types, privacy-driven data obfuscation reducing label signal, task heterogeneity, and that it is a non-LLM, vision-focused benchmark which may be small or specialized for some categories.
